objectives.title: Everyday greetings & politeness
objectives.canDo: I can recognise and write the everyday French greetings and politeness formulas — bonjour, bonsoir, salut, au revoir, merci, s'il vous plaît — and pick the right one for the situation.
objectives.evidenceNote: Formulas are assessed in written recognition and typed form only — spoken use is not yet assessed.

objectives.title: Core everyday nouns
objectives.canDo: I can understand and name the course's core everyday words — people, food and drink, animals, and other common everyday things — when I read them.

objectives.title: Places & travel words
objectives.canDo: I can understand the French words for common places and travel needs — la ville, la gare, l'hôtel, le billet — when I read them.

objectives.title: Time & calendar words
objectives.canDo: I can use the French words for counting time — le jour, l'heure, la minute, la semaine, le mois, l'année.

objectives.title: Reading familiar words & short phrases
objectives.canDo: I can recognise familiar French words and very short learned phrases when I see them written, and match them to their meaning.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at Pre-A1 only: the course genuinely assesses written recognition of familiar words and learned phrases. A1 reading (short simple texts) is not yet assessed.

objectives.title: Writing familiar words & forms
objectives.canDo: I can type familiar French words and learned forms with the right spelling, including accents — mangé, être, vingt et un.
objectives.evidenceNote: Evidence is single words and short learned forms, not composed sentences.

objectives.title: Articles with familiar nouns
objectives.canDo: I can choose the right article — le or la, un or une — for the familiar nouns I have learned.

objectives.title: Gender from word endings
objectives.canDo: I can use reliable French endings — -tion, -ance, -ité, -ment, -age, -eau — to predict whether a new noun takes le or la.

objectives.title: Être & avoir in the present
objectives.canDo: I can use the present-tense forms of être and avoir with every subject — je suis, tu as, nous sommes, ils ont.

objectives.title: Regular -er verbs in the present
objectives.canDo: I can conjugate regular -er verbs like parler, aimer and habiter in the present tense for every subject.

objectives.title: Aller & faire in the present
objectives.canDo: I can use the present-tense forms of aller and faire — je vais, elle va, nous faisons, ils font.

objectives.title: Near future with aller
objectives.canDo: I can talk about plans by putting aller in front of any verb — Je vais manger, Nous allons parler.

objectives.title: Past tense with avoir
objectives.canDo: I can build the everyday past tense with avoir plus a participle — J'ai mangé, Tu as parlé — for the verbs I know.
objectives.evidenceNote: Introduced with avoir-auxiliary verbs only; être-auxiliary verbs and agreement are not yet taught.

objectives.title: Numbers 0-100
objectives.canDo: I can understand and write every French number from zéro to cent, including the et-un pattern, soixante-dix and quatre-vingts.
objectives.evidenceNote: Numbers are read and typed; understanding spoken numbers is not yet assessed.

objectives.title: Elision in writing
objectives.canDo: I can apply mandatory French elision in writing — l'eau, j'ai, ce n'est pas — and never write je ai or le homme.

objectives.title: Liaison & the two h's
objectives.canDo: I can recognise where French links words together — les amis, nous avons — where it never does, and why l'histoire but le héros.
objectives.evidenceNote: Rule recognition only — actual pronunciation is not assessed.

objectives.title: Cognate bridges & false friends
objectives.canDo: I can use the -tion and -té bridges to understand new French words from English — and I know the classic traps like librairie and journée.

objectives.title: Hearing familiar words & phrases
objectives.canDo: I can understand familiar words and very short learned phrases when I hear them spoken clearly and slowly.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at Pre-A1 only: bundled clear synthesized single-word/short-phrase clips, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint. Natural conversational speech and accent variety are NOT assessed.

objectives.title: Catching concrete details by ear
objectives.canDo: I can pick out concrete information — places, times, prices and numbers — from a short, clear, slow recording about everyday things.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1 within bundled-audio scope: short synthesized factual recordings with 1-3 information units, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint. Authentic-speed media are NOT assessed.

objectives.title: Following short announcements & instructions
objectives.canDo: I can follow very short, simple everyday announcements and instructions when they are spoken clearly and slowly.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1 within bundled-audio scope: synthesized station/shop-style announcements and simple instructions, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint.

objectives.title: Following a short conversation
objectives.canDo: I can follow the main point of a very short, simple conversation between two people speaking clearly about everyday things.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1 within bundled-audio scope: two-voice synthesized exchanges of 2-4 turns, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint. The learner listens only — interaction is NOT assessed.

objectives.title: Reading short messages
objectives.canDo: I can understand short, simple written messages — notes, texts and simple postcards — about everyday plans and needs.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1: original short messages read and answered in the Section-3 checkpoint.

objectives.title: Finding information in notices & signs
objectives.canDo: I can find concrete information in everyday notices, signs, opening hours and simple practical texts.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1: original notices/schedules with locate-type questions, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint.

objectives.title: Understanding short simple texts
objectives.canDo: I can understand short, very simple descriptive texts about familiar topics, reading slowly and re-reading when I need to.
objectives.evidenceNote: Direct at A1: original 2-5 sentence descriptions/micro-narratives, scored in the Section-3 checkpoint. Longer or unfamiliar-topic texts are NOT assessed.
